title: Meta updates a support page to say that end-to-end encrypted messaging on Instagram will no longer be supported after May 8 (Karandeep Singh Oberoi/Android Police)
summary: Karandeep Singh Oberoi / Android Police: Meta updates a support page to say that end-to-end encrypted messaging on Instagram will no longer be supported after May 8 — Can you imagine a world where WhatsApp stops offering end-to-end encryption (E2EE)? That's not happening, but a different Meta-owned company …
contentText:
Karandeep Singh Oberoi / Android Police :

Meta says Instagram will no longer support end-to-end encrypted messages starting May 8, saying “very few people” were using E2EE in their DMs   —  Can you imagine a world where WhatsApp stops offering end-to-end encryption (E2EE)?  That's not happening, but a different Meta-owned company …
